# Statistical tests added in revision 2 (generated by `stats_tests.py`)

- Well-mixed pairing (Stage H) against lattice pairing (Stage G), L = 16, worlds closed by 300,000 steps: 7 of 10 against 20 of 20 (source: results/review_r2/FIRST_CLOSURE.md and the Stage H outcome in REVISION_PREREG); two-sided Fisher exact P = 0.030
- Closure at the aligned lengths L = 16, 32, 64 (20 of 20 by 300,000 steps; 12 of 20 and 8 of 20 by one million; Stage G and K tables): Cochran–Armitage trend test on log2 L, z = -4.02, two-sided P = 5.7e-05. The shorter horizon at L = 16 makes the test conservative.
